scripts.build: bun run build:rust && bun run build:workspace
scripts.format: prettier --write .github apps compatibility design scripts tools CONTRIBUTING.md README.md THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md eslint.config.js package.json playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .github apps compatibility design scripts tools CONTRIBUTING.md README.md THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md eslint.config.js package.json playwright.config.ts tsconfig.json
scripts.test:browser: bun run build:rust && bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun x playwright test
scripts.test:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked -- --test-threads=1
scripts.test:fast: bun run check:album-language && bun run test:license && bun run test:docker-context && bun run test:compose-storage && bun run test:workflow && bun run test:rust && bun run --cwd apps/web test:unit && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test:browser
scripts.verify: bun run format:check && bun run test:fast && bun run build
